title: atropa bella-donna f. lutea
intro: Atropa bella-donna f. lutea, commonly known as Devil's Trumpet, is a subspecies of the deadly nightshade plant (Atropa belladonna). It is a perennial plant native to Europe, known for its shiny leaves and bell-shaped flowers. The health benefits of Devil's Trumpet include its use in traditional medicine to treat various conditions such as anxiety, insomnia, and pain, although its use is not widely recognized due to the toxicity of its bioactive constituents. The therapeutic actions of this plant include sedative, anti-inflammatory, and spasmolytic effects, attributed to bioactive constituents such as scopolamine, hyoscyamine, and atropine, which are alkaloids that have a calming effect on the nervous system and can also reduce inflammation and muscle spasms.
